examples.rationale: E1 matches E5/E7 (R1) and E8/E10 (R2) showing the same submarine and background, indicating the claim image is a crop of an older South Korean navy photo. I will check R1’s publication date to establish when this image was first published online.

R2 (News18) is a near-identical match found by Yandex and mentions hoardings in Andhra during Modi’s visit; checking its publication and platform upload dates will help determine when and where this image first appeared online, addressing the task’s core requirement.

E10 contains the full text of the News18 article (R2) whose thumbnail matches E1 and is dated 2019-02-10 (E17); reading it will reveal the article's stated location and context for the billboard to compare against the Rajasthan claim.

E1 matches E4 and E6 from R1 (Amar Ujala), confirming the image source; now checking R1's publication date to determine when it first appeared and whether the context supports the 2023 Makar Sankranti claim.

R1 (Sotwe) shows a near-identical image match but lacks date data; R2's page is archived only from 2023-12-08, after the claim date. Checking R3 (dtnext.in) for publication or archive dates may reveal an earlier occurrence of the image to establish first publication.
Image E1 matches E4 from WIRED article R1; I need the publication date of R1 to determine if the image predates the May 2023 claim and verify its original context.

Image E5 from R2 visually matches the original image E1, showing the same leaders in the same setting, indicating R2 may be an early publication of the image. This action will retrieve the publication date of R2 to assess whether it predates the claim date of 2023-01-16 and helps establish the image's original context.

R6 (yemennewstoday.wordpress.com) shows a partial-match thumbnail of the boy in rubble; checking its declared publication date and earliest archive capture will establish whether this source predates the June 2022 Afghanistan earthquake claim and help determine the image's original context.

R6's page date (2016-10-25, E21) predates the 2022 claim, but its thumbnail was only a partial match; R7's article image (E18) also showed a partial match. Checking R7's publication and capture dates will determine if it is an earlier or independent source for Material A.

E16 is the text page for candidate source R6 (Yemen News Today), which returned a partial image match in the reverse search; reading it will reveal the article's date and context to determine if this image was published before the June 2022 earthquake claim.

R5 (NDTV article) appeared in reverse image search with a thumbnail not matching E1; checking its publication date via SEARCH on R5 will establish whether this source predates the 2023-02-08 claim and could represent an earlier context for the image.

Image E1 matches candidate sources R1 (CBS News) and R2 (blogspot) visually; R1 is a credible news archive likely to include publication dates. This SEARCH will retrieve the page's declared publication date and earliest archive capture to establish when the image first appeared online and assess whether it predates the 2023 claim.
